# CLI tokens intentionally not spelled out in the docs. Each entry needs a reason.
# Format: token # reason
--line-fraction # expert derule tuning; covered by kurrent-reader derule --help
--split # expert derule option; covered by --help
--mode # segmentation mode choice; covered by --help, default fits most scans
--model # expert kraken model selection; covered by --help
--model-id # expert alternate HF model; covered by --help
--quantize # expert int8 quantization toggle; covered by --help
--seg-model # expert segmentation model path; covered by --help
